architecture: Deep Gated Gross V2 + formal cost firewall + notional multiplier/cap sweep
selection_policy: live selected candidate uses validation-only score, must stay within current live cap and margin fraction, must survive validation 2x/3x cost stress, and must beat the audited cost firewall baseline on validation PnL
red_team_notes: Raising notional increases PnL and MDD mechanically; live selection is capped by current bot/exchange leverage assumptions.
Diagnostic candidates above the current live cap are reported but not selected for live use.
Liquidation and maintenance margin are approximated in replay; any live injection still needs exchange-specific reduceOnly/order sizing checks.
